name: Dull status inbox for deliver/seal
goal: Make synth status print exact copy-pasteable deliver --branch and seal --merge-commit commands, fixing NoExecutionBranch fallback, ledgerBranch missing fallback, and shallow-clone hint, so fresh Arena sessions can seal after pull without extra queries.

metadata.refinementNote: Implemented the four drafted changes plus one in-scope discovery: resolveCheckpointBranch (src/cli/synth.ts) built its branch context by hand and never consulted the recorded ADR-056 binding, so 'synth checkpoint' reported status:blocked for an expedition executing on a declared arena/* branch; it now enriches via enrichExecutionBranchContext and matches the executing expedition by recorded binding before canonical name. Scope extension: tests/ledger-delivery.test.js and tests/ledger-ceremony.test.js were necessarily modified (outside the drafted four-file scope) to cover the new behaviour; one existing ceremony assertion encoded the old behaviour (a configured ledger branch that does not exist locally was returned verbatim) and now creates the branch so it still tests config-over-record precedence, with a new test covering the fallback.
